msg: The color of the gnome does not affect the amount of mushrooms you gain, neither does the type of hat the gnome is wearing. The gnome on the left hand side('s' key gnome) gets you more mushrooms majority of the time, when you get under 5 mushrooms from the 's' key gnome then just switch to the 'k' key gnome for a little bit and then just go back to the gnome on the left side. Also don't double tap, just tap the key needed once when you see a gnome or the basket.
